name: Uniform Sampling Evaluation
definition: An evaluation protocol for surface reconstruction that eliminates vertex-density bias by uniformly sampling a fixed number of points from the reconstructed mesh surface within the ground truth (GT) crop volume, ensuring a strictly fair geometric comparison.
summary: Uniform Sampling Evaluation is a geometric protocol that eliminates vertex-density bias by uniformly sampling a fixed number of points from the reconstructed mesh surface, ensuring fair comparison decoupled from tessellation quality.
